title: CLAUSE-OPTION-001 — Option fidelity
description: A loaded option appears with its package name in the formats that must carry it. An explicit gap is not invented. A non-redistributable -bin candidate may be named as deferred fetch and its binary does not travel. Legacy command fields and host bootstrap tooling never appear as content.

gapOptionIds.description: Canonical ids that remain explicit gaps (not loaded).

forbiddenTokens.description: Must be empty: no legacy-command-field, host-bootstrap, hook or interpreter tokens.

embeddedBinaries.description: Must be empty: -bin blobs do not travel inside the artifact.

deferredFetchNames.description: Non-redistributable package names cited only as deferred obtainment.
